lines.4: 「You all assembled as promised. Let us depart.」
lines.7: With that, Otome headed down to the first floor.
lines.8: Then out to the athletic field.
lines.10: 「Past the gym from here, you've got the kenpo hall, kendo hall, aikido hall, then judo hall.」
lines.11: Ryuumeikan had an impressive collection of training halls.
lines.12: The detached archery hall was still wooden because it had never even been renovated.
lines.13: 「Y-you aren't planning to drag us into a dojo and beat some spirit into us, are you...?」
lines.14: 「Nothing of the sort. We are going beyond the training halls.」
lines.16: 「Our appointment is with the mistress of the building beside it.」
lines.17: 「Beside the cafeteria? You don't mean Ryugu, do you?」
lines.18: Ryugu--the student council executive committee's independent wooden building.
lines.19: It earned the name because generations of student council presidents--all women--had run the council from there.
lines.20: Which meant the person waiting inside was--
